observations: Photo 0 shows a used automotive gearbox resting on a dark surface.
The gearbox has a heavy, industrial appearance with visible rust and dirt.
A metal plate is attached to the side of the gearbox, but the text on it is illegible.
The background is dark and cluttered, suggesting a workshop or storage environment.
A watermark 'SOMITO GREAT' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: No Hyundai Santa Fe is visible in the photo.
No 4WD indicator is visible in the photo.
No coolant reservoir or fluid lines are visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be a used part rather than a new direct replacement.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually stamped on the housing).

risks.risk: The gearbox may be missing the necessary 4WD transfer case or clutch assembly.
risks.proof: A photo showing the complete 4WD unit (gearbox + transfer case).

risks.risk: The gearbox may be seized, stripped, or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of the gearbox being manually rotated or a close-up of the output shaft.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the gearbox.
Photo of the complete 4WD unit (gearbox + transfer case).
Video of the gearbox being tested for movement.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
